title: Kae's Soulbound: Turnbattles modifications
description: This modpack adds some customizations to the mod Soulbound: Turnbattles! just some personal changes that I felt like adding.
body: This resourcepack aims to modify certain aspects of Soulbound Turnbattles! These changes are of personal liking but I feel like sharing them to the public! This pack will get updates as the mod does and the version of the pack mirrors the version of the mod its made for.
